verdict.rationale: Fly.io converts Docker images into hardware-isolated, fast-booting VMs that run close to users worldwide, with each workload getting a full Linux box. Any unmodified runtime, Node.js included, therefore runs without a restricted edge-runtime subset. It is a VM/container model rather than a functions model, and support for Node.js is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit Node.js/npm documentation, a function-style (per-request serverless) deployment model, and independent hands-on corroboration of running unmodified Node apps at the edge.
